entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Ms. Aradhana Singh, learned counsel for the revisionist, Ms.Gunjan Sharma, learned
counsel for opposite party no.3, High Court Legal Services Committee, Allahabad and learned Aga
for the State and perused the record.

2. This criminal revision has been filed for setting aside the order dated 30.05.2023 passed by
Principal Magistrate Juvenile Justice Board, Kanpur Nagar and order dated 11.07.2023 passed by
Special Judge (Pocso Act)/ Additional Sessions Judge, Kanpur Nagar in Criminal Appeal No.70 of
2023 affirming the order of J. J. Board declining bail to the juvenile in case crime no.1106 of 2022,
under Sections 363, 366 and 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 Pocso Act, P.S. Chakeri, District Kanpur Nagar.
3.
In this case initially an F.I.R. was lodged under Sections 363 and 366 I.P.C. on the basis of the report from the father of minor girl that she did not return to her house from coaching.
Family members came to know from her friends that she used to talk to accused and probably he has abducted her.
The girl was recovered.
During investigation her statements under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. were recorded.
She was put to medical examination.
Finding the accused involved in the case as minor he was produced before the J.J.Board.
His application for release to custody of his parents was refused.

His appeal challenging the aforesaid order was also dismissed declining him Juvenile 'X' (Minor) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84911951/
1 bail.
4.

entities.text: Juvenile 'X' (Minor) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted on behalf of the revisionist that the revisionist has been falsely implicated in this case.
The boy is aged about 16 years and 11 months and the victim is aged about 14 years.
Statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. do not largely support the prosecution story.
The medical report does not support forcible sexual assault.

Further it is submitted that social investigation report has not shown any adverse remarks as regard his behavior, antecedents or conduct so as to bring the matter within three exclusionary clauses as provided in proviso to Section 12 of the Juvenile Justice Care and Protection Act,2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice Care and Protection Act,2015.
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The juvenile is in protection home since 30.12.2022 i.e. last one year three months now.
5. Learned AGA has opposed prayer for bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.
6. I went through all the material on record including bail rejection order passed by Juvenile Justice Board.

It appears that the board without any substantive material, has given opinion that in fact there is probability of his having been exposed to physical moral, psychological danger or that release may defeat ends of justice and has dismissed the bail application.
The appellate court appears to have agreed with the opinion of the board.
In this case minor was found aged about 16 years and 11 months and the alleged victim was about 14 years.
The juvenile is in custody since 30.12.2022.

Nothing adverse has been found in social investigation report as regard his behavior,
conduct or antecedents.
7. In my view, the matter does not fall within three exclusionary clauses as provided in proviso to Section 12 of the Act, 2015.

It is settled law that whenever a minor, who is alleged to have committed an offence, is apprehended and produced before the board, he shall be released on bail unless the release is likely to bring him in association with any known criminal or there is likelihood of exposure to moral or psychological danger or that such release would defeat ends of justice.
8. In view of the above, especially, in view of the period of incarceration already undergone, the revision is allowed.

The the order dated 30.05.2023 passed by Principal Magistrate Juvenile Justice Board, Kanpur Nagar and order dated 11.07.2023 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act)/ Additional Sessions Judge, Kanpur Nagar are hereby set aside.
